title: FTSubRow
html:
定义组：一阶语法与替换。有序参数：F、f、z1289、z1290、z1291。

项中的变量替换，没有量词捕获问题。：单行局部条件。

规范公式

(@ FTSubRow F f z1289 z1290 z1291) 按 无捕获缩写规则 展开为下列有限公式。参数只取集合，不能填入函数项或元语言公式。

(exists x
  (exists s
    (exists t
      (exists u
        (and
          (exists z1294
            (and (exists z1295 (and (@ Pair t u z1295) (@ Pair s z1295 z1294))) (@ Pair x z1294 z1291)))
          (and
            (@ Nat x)
            (and
              (@ FTerm F f s)
              (and
                (@ FTerm F f t)
                (and
                  (@ FTerm F f u)
                  (or
                    (exists z1296 (and (@ FVar z1296 t) (or (and (= z1296 x) (= u s)) (and (not (= z1296 x)) (= t u)))))
                    (exists z1297
                      (exists z1298
                        (exists z1299
                          (exists z1300
                            (and
                            (@ FFun z1297 z1298 t)
                            (and
                            (@ FFun z1297 z1299 u)
                            (and
                            (@ Seq z1298 z1300)
                            (and
                            (@ Seq z1299 z1300)
                            (forall z1301
                            (implies
                            (in z1301 z1300)
                            (exists z1302
                            (exists z1303
                            (and
                            (@ App z1298 z1301 z1302)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1299 z1301 z1303)
                            (exists z1304
                            (exists z1305
                            (and
                            (in z1304 z1290)
                            (and
                            (@ App z1289 z1304 z1305)
                            (exists z1306
                            (and (exists z1307 (and (@ Pair z1302 z1303 z1307) (@ Pair s z1307 z1306))) (@ Pair x z1306 z1305)))))))))))))))))))))))))))))))

直接依赖

App；FFun；FTerm；FVar；Nat；Pair；Seq
